name: A Warm Welcome
desc: Elder Maren wants to see whether a newcomer can feed themselves.

stages.j: Elder Maren asked me to prove I can live off the Vale. I should chop a log, light it, and cook something on it.
I need to chop some logs from a tree near the village.
Now I need to catch a shrimp at the river or coast with a small fishing net.
I should cook the shrimp on a fire or range.
Time to show Elder Maren what I have managed.

name: Rats in the Cellar
desc: Something is eating the Amber Hearth's winter stores.

stages.j: Pell Ashcroft says giant rats have taken the inn cellar. He gave me the key.
I need to clear out six giant rats.
The cellar is clear. I should tell Pell.

name: The Blacksmith's Apprentice
desc: Dura Coldiron needs stock and has no patience for excuses.

stages.j: Dura wants five bronze daggers made from scratch.
I need to smelt bronze bars from copper and tin, then smith five bronze daggers.
I should bring the daggers to Dura.

name: The Missing Fisherman
desc: A fisherman walked out at dawn and never came back.

stages.j: Rosa says a fisherman is missing somewhere along the southern coast.
I should search the rocky coast west of Saltbrook.
I found his pipe on the rocks. I should pick it up.
Nell Quay in Saltbrook should see this.

name: Banner of the Broken Tooth
desc: The goblins west of Oakheart have grown bold enough to plant a flag.

stages.j: Guard Tomas wants the goblin war banner taken down.
I should thin out the goblin camp - eight of them.
The banner is somewhere in the camp.
I should return the banner to Tomas.

name: Seeds of Doubt
desc: Oswin insists anyone can farm. Prove him right.

stages.j: Oswin gave me potato seeds and a dibber. I should plant them in his allotment.
I need to grow and harvest three potatoes.
I should bring the potatoes back to Oswin.

name: The Barnacled Crate
desc: Something heavy keeps fouling the Saltbrook nets.

stages.j: Nell says a crate keeps tangling the nets off the point.
I should search the water off the southern point.
I need to haul up the crate.
Captain Rell should see what was inside.

name: The Aldermere Ledger
desc: Three pages are missing from the city record, and the thief left a riddle.

stages.j: Venn is missing three ledger pages. They were scattered across the realm.
One page is said to be in the Oakheart inn.
A second page is in the Mirefen ruins.
The last page is somewhere in Dunhollow.

stages.q: The thief left a note: "I am kept full to be useful, emptied to be moved, and buried to be safe. What am I?"
stages.j: Venn read the thief's riddle aloud. I need to answer it.
I should tell Venn what I worked out.

name: A Light Touch
desc: Kito Sly measures trust in stolen purses.

stages.j: Kito wants proof I can pick a pocket without being caught.
I need three purses lifted from Aldermere citizens.
Time to hand the purses over.

name: The Alchemist's Debt
desc: Morra Blackfen pays her debts in knowledge, eventually.

stages.j: Morra will teach herblore if I clean and brew for her.
I need four clean marshleaf.
Now I must brew two attack potions.
I should deliver the potions to Morra.

name: Feathers and Patience
desc: Arn Yewbend will trade a pattern for proof of steady hands.

stages.j: Arn wants a shortbow and thirty arrows, all my own work.
I need to fletch a shortbow from logs and string it.
I need thirty bronze arrows.
I should show Arn my work.

name: The Miner's Tally
desc: Gwen Tally lost count, and the foreman is coming.

stages.j: Gwen needs ore to balance her tally before inspection.
I need eight copper ore.
And eight tin ore.
I should hand the ore to Gwen.

name: Dunhollow Descent
desc: The lower seam collapsed and something came up through the gap.

stages.j: Borin needs the lower seam cleared of whatever crawled in.
I should kill six cave crawlers in the deep mine.
Borin also wants ten coal hauled up as proof the seam is workable.
Time to report to Borin.

name: The Frozen Forge
desc: Hega Frostforge needs a living ember from the ice.

stages.j: Hega needs an ember from the ice caves to relight the great forge.
Ice trolls guard the upper caves. Three should clear a path.
I need to recover the Frostforge ember.
I should bring the ember back to Hega.

name: Whispers in Mirefen
desc: The ruins have started speaking at night, and answering back.

stages.j: Morra gave me a lantern and told me to walk the ruins at night.
I should reach the heart of the Mirefen ruins.
The dead rose. I need to put ten of them back down.
Three wraiths are holding the ruin. They must go.
Morra needs to hear what I found.

name: Runes of the Old Circle
desc: The standing stones north of Oakheart still hum.

stages.j: Ilvara wants the old stone circle surveyed.
I should find the standing stones northwest of Oakheart.
A tablet lies at the centre of the circle.
Ilvara wants twenty-five air runes crafted at the circle.
I should bring the tablet and runes to Ilvara.

name: The Watcher's Tower
desc: The lens that watches the Blightlands has gone dark.

stages.j: Sil needs the tower lens recovered. The stair is gone - I will have to climb.
I should reach the ruined watchtower.
The lens is at the top of the tower.
Blight hounds have the tower surrounded. Six of them.
I should return the lens to Sil.

name: The Pilgrim's Token
desc: Brother Aldo asks for bones returned to the earth and a shrine relit.

stages.j: Aldo asked me to bury bones and relight the roadside shrine.
I need fifteen bones for the rites.
The roadside shrine lies between Oakheart and Mirefen.
The shrine is lit. I should tell Aldo.

name: Crown of the Deep
desc: The Drowned Captain has been collecting crowns. And crews.

stages.j: Rell wants the Drowned Captain dealt with. The pirates hold the southern isle.
I should clear ten deckhands from the isle.
Now for the Drowned Captain himself.
I should take the crown as proof.
Rell is waiting at the harbour.

name: The Crown of Grothak
desc: Killing the banner-bearers only made them elect a king.

stages.j: The goblins crowned a king. Tomas wants him gone.
His brutes stand between me and the throne - eight of them.
Time to face Grothak.
Elder Maren should hear that the Vale is safe.

name: Mother of Mires
desc: Something under the bog has been laying eggs for a very long time.

stages.j: Morra says the whispers came from something beneath the bog.
Her brood must be thinned first - twelve lurkers.
Now to face the Mother of Mires.
Morra will want the tooth.

name: Ashes of the Warden
desc: The thing that burned the Blightlands is still standing in the middle of them.

stages.j: Venn believes the Warden of Ash can be unmade with its own sigil.
Ten corrupted knights guard the approach.
Six shamans maintain the ward around the Warden.
The Warden stands at the heart of the Blightfort.
Now I must destroy the Warden of Ash.
Venn is waiting in the Aldermere archive.

name: The Long Road Home
desc: Old Hob claims to have seen every corner of the realm. Prove you have too.

stages.j: Hob wants me to stand in all six regions and bring back his journal.
First: Dunhollow, high in the Kragmar Peaks.
Second: the Mirefen ruins in the western bog.
Third: the harbour at Saltbrook.
Fourth: the city of Aldermere.
Fifth: the Blightfort in the east.
Hob left his journal somewhere on the road. I should find it.
Back to Old Hob in Oakheart.
